content_sections.heading: About CUPB Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Central University of Punjab, Bathinda was established vide Act No. 25 (2009) of Parliament and is located at VPO Ghudda, Distt. Bathinda. The Project Assistant will work on the university's autism research project led by Dr. Mahalaxmi Balachandar, Principal Investigator, Department of Community Medicine and Health. The Co-Principal Investigators are Prof. Amandeep Kaur, Dean of the School of Engineering and Technology and Professor in the Department of Computer Science & Technology, and Prof. Balachandar Vellingiri, Professor in the Department of Zoology.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree in any one of the following disciplines: M.Sc., Community Medicine / M.Sc., Public Health / M.Sc. Biotechnology / Medicine / M. Pharm. and any other relevant/allied subject. Minimum two years research experience with at least one research paper in SCI journals. Project Assistant selection will be prioritized based on the requirements of the proposed project, and the candidate should possess a Master's degree in one of the disciplines listed above. Priority should be given to PhD candidates who do not have a fellowship under the Principal Investigator's guidance; otherwise, the selected Project Assistant may be considered to register for a PhD in the same institution as the Principal Investigator to continue the project. The selected Project Assistant may be required to travel to Mizoram for sample collection and analysis, and should have basic experience in basic cell culture techniques. The age limit is up to 35 years as on the date of interview. The relaxation is permissible as per Government of India rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments: ₹ 8,000/- (As per University norms). The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. Term of engagement: initially for six months, extendable up to the duration of the project based on performance and availability of the fund. The post is purely temporary for a limited period or the duration of the research project funded by the funding agency. The selected Project Assistant shall not accept or hold any appointment, paid or otherwise, or receive any emoluments, salary or stipend from any other source during the tenure of the appointment. The rules and regulations of CUPB and the funding agency will apply to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUPB Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the prescribed format. Email it to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] on or before the date of the interview, 12 November 2026. Bring the application form along with testimonials to the interview. Carry the original documents, which must be shown at the time of interaction cum interview and/or joining. Application form in the prescribed format Testimonials Original documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates shall be called for the interaction cum interview through email. The interview details printed in the notice are: Date of interview: 12 November 2026 Reporting time: 11:00 AM Venue: Department of Community Medicine and Health, Aryabhata Academic Block, Central University of Punjab, VPO Ghudda, Distt. Bathinda No T.A/D.A. or any other allowances will be paid for attending the interaction cum interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CUPB Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (one) Project Assistant post under advertisement PRO – 358 (2026).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CUPB Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before the date of the interview, 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CUPB Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in M.Sc., Community Medicine / M.Sc., Public Health / M.Sc. Biotechnology / Medicine / M. Pharm. or any other relevant/allied subject is required, with minimum two years research experience and at least one research paper in SCI journals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CUPB Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 35 years as on the date of interview, with 5 years' relaxation for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CUPB Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The emoluments are ₹ 8,000/- (As per University norms).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CUPB Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format to [email protected] on or before 12 November 2026, and bring the application form with testimonials to the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the CUPB Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called through email for an interaction cum interview on 12 November 2026, reporting at 11:00 AM in the Department of Community Medicine and Health, Aryabhata Academic Block.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CUPB Project Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary for the duration of the research project, initially for six months and extendable based on performance and availability of the fund.

faq.question: Q9. Will the CUPB Project Assistant have to travel?
faq.answer: The selected Project Assistant may be required to travel to Mizoram for sample collection and analysis.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel allowance paid for attending the CUPB interview?
faq.answer: No, no T.A/D.A. or any other allowances will be paid for attending the interaction cum interview.
